_comment: The scenarios (docs/specs/scenarios.md, D5.4): a modifier set for the whole run plus start-state overrides, no hooks. start.compute replaces balance.compute.start; start.origin_eligible is added to the origin rule; start.statuses land at the origin on every region their rule passes; containment_at_discovery is added to the tracks on the day of discovery, never before; start.flags are story flags set at the origin. All three unlock together after unlock.runs_completed completed runs (the profile decides). Loaded from S5.8 on. Text: SCENARIO_<ID>_NAME / _TAGLINE / _DETAIL / _INTRO.
